supporting_evidence.interpretation: Physical layer errors (740) detected on switchport interface for BLDG-SW-HOSTEL-A.

High physical interface errors (740) correlated with packet loss (14.2%) indicates physical layer / transceiver degradation.
High physical interface errors (18) correlated with packet loss (12.8%) indicates physical layer / transceiver degradation.

recommended_actions: Dispatch field technician to inspect physical cable, transceiver, and optical power levels on AP-HOSTEL-A1, BLDG-SW-HOSTEL-A.
Review interface FCS, CRC error counters, and runt/giant packet statistics on switch ports.
Execute clean cable swap or migrate uplink to alternate transceiver/port pair.
Verify switch backplane error logs and run self-diagnostic test suite (POST/BIST).
limitations: Topological context: Upstream node BLDG-SW-HOSTEL-A (bldg_switch) is itself anomalous, explaining all downstream failures.
